column1: # libkernl kernel patches, built from source by tools/kpatch.py and embedded in their owner files' .data
# (docs/engine/sony-libkernl-sys.md#the-kernel-patches). The patch links at its run address, its .text and
# .data become build/<GAMEID>/kpatch/<name>.inc, and the owner unit includes that as the initializer of its array.
# A patch compiles with its owner unit's flags and the owner's compiler, or the units.tsv compiler named here.

column2: sources (`-` while the owner still names the retail array)
